name: claude-roslyn-lsp
description: Microsoft's Roslyn language server, mediated for Claude Code: navigation and edit-time diagnostics over LSP, plus an MCP refactoring surface (rename, code actions, fix-all, format, diagnostics on demand).

solution.title: Solution or project file
solution.description: Absolute or repository-relative path to the .slnx, .sln or .csproj to load. Leave blank and the adapter discovers one, honouring .vscode/settings.json's dotnet.defaultSolution; set it in a monorepo, where the discovered solution is often not the one you are working in. A path that is not there fails with a message rather than falling back to a guess.

roslyn_version.title: Roslyn language server version
roslyn_version.description: Overrides the pinned roslyn-language-server version the adapter downloads. Blank uses the version this release was tested against; anything else has no hash to verify against, is reported by doctor as unverified, and may not accept the same command line.

roslyn_path.title: Roslyn language server path
roslyn_path.description: Directory holding an already-installed Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.LanguageServer.dll. Set it to run air-gapped or to test a locally built server; blank downloads the pinned version into the plugin's data directory.

log_level.title: Log level
log_level.description: Trace, Debug, Information, Warning, Error, Critical or None (default Information). Logs go to stderr, which Claude Code shows with --debug; stdout is the protocol channel and never carries anything else.
